title: Auto-fill
subtitle: Check the setup before the timetable is generated.

ready.title: Ready to generate
ready.body: Your setup has everything auto-fill needs.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.hint: These will not stop auto-fill, but the result may fall short.

continueHelp: Fix the problems above to continue.

messages.plan-empty: {{class}} has no subjects in its plan.
messages.plan-exceeds-template: {{class}} needs {{needed}} a week, but its template has only {{available}}.
messages.per-day-unbuildable: {{class}}: {{item}} needs {{minutes}} on {{days}}, which the periods that day cannot add up to.
messages.no-qualified-teacher: No teacher with Grade {{grade}} in their grades teaches {{subject}} ({{classes}}).
messages.no-specialist: {{subject}} needs a teacher other than the class teacher ({{classes}}).
messages.class-teacher-no-daily-subject: {{teacher}}, class teacher of {{class}}, must teach a subject here with at least 5 periods a week (so they can take the first period every day).
messages.class-teacher-wrong-grade: {{teacher}} is class teacher of {{class}} but is not assigned to grade {{grade}}.
messages.capacity-short: {{subject}} needs {{needed}} periods a week, but teachers can cover only {{capacity}}.
messages.min-per-week-unreachable: Teachers' minimum weekly lessons add up to {{needed}}, but only {{available}} lessons are planned.

options.title: How should auto-fill treat the current timetable?
options.label: Existing lessons
options.fillAroundHint: Keep every lesson already placed and fill only what is missing.
options.startOverHint: Replace the lessons of the grades you pick. Other grades stay as they are.
options.replace_one: {{count}} hand-placed slot in these grades will be replaced.
options.replace_other: {{count}} hand-placed slots in these grades will be replaced.
options.nothingToReplace: These grades have no lessons yet.

running.title: Generating the timetable…
running.hint: This takes up to about 10 seconds. Nothing is saved yet.
running.best_one: Best so far: {{count}} period not placed
running.best_other: Best so far: {{count}} periods not placed

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Nothing is saved until you press Save.
preview.samePattern: {{percent}}% of subjects in the same slot all week
preview.stale: You changed the allocation. Re-run placement to see the new timetable.
preview.clash: The timetable changed since you generated this — run again.
preview.busy: Someone else is saving to this timetable. Try again in a moment.
preview.partial: Saving stopped part-way ({{written}} lessons written, {{deleted}} removed). Run auto-fill again with Fill around to finish.
preview.failed: Could not save the timetable. Please try again.

allocation.hint: Who teaches each subject. Change a teacher, then re-run placement.
allocation.empty: Nothing to allocate: every class already has its lessons.

classes.legend: Outlined lessons are new. The others are already in the timetable.

reason.staffing: The staffing rules leave no teacher for it.
reason.no-free-teacher: {{teacher}} is busy whenever the class is free on {{day}}.
reason.no-free-teacher-any: No teacher is free when the class is free.
reason.no-room: The class has no free periods left for it.
reason.minutes-unbuildable: {{minutes}} cannot be made from the free periods on {{day}}.
reason.minutes-unbuildable-week: {{minutes}} cannot be made from the free periods.
reason.block-unavailable: No period on {{day}} is free for every class and teacher in the block.
reason.block-unavailable-week: No period is free for every class and teacher in the block.
